description.zh: Spark作业ID。您可以在作业管理页面查看作业。
description.en: The Spark job ID. You can view the job on the job management page.

description.zh: 执行Spark作业的虚拟集群名称。您可以在虚拟集群管理页面查看虚拟集群名称。
description.en: The name of the virtual cluster that runs the Spark job. You can view the virtual cluster name on the virtual cluster management page.
